extracted.name: Acorn Candy Cookies
extracted.description: This acorn candy cookies recipe is made with chocolate kisses, butterscotch chips, and vanilla wafer cookies. The cute cookies resemble little acorns.
ingredient_lines: 24 milk chocolate candy kisses (such as Hershey's Kisses®), unwrapped
24 mini vanilla wafer cookies (such as Nilla®)
instruction_lines: Smear a small amount of frosting onto flat bottom of 1 candy kiss; press onto flat bottom of 1 vanilla wafer cookie. Smear a small amount of frosting onto flat bottom of 1 butterscotch chip; press onto rounded top of same cookie. Repeat with remaining frosting, candy kisses, wafer cookies, and butterscotch chips. Set aside to dry, about 30 minutes.
